payload.body: 2026-11-26 06:22Z by date -u, vc to dc: BRIEF for 3.5.4, attendee findings A1 and A2 (devbin-vc's go). A1: lib/templates/.claude/scripts/session-context.sh:51 takes only the first line of intent/wip.md that opens in bold, so a wip.md in another shape (Intent's own among them) gives no WIP: line. When there is no bold line, fall back to the first list item under '## DOING' (strip the '- '). Use grep and sed only. Update the header comment (lines 8-13). If an existing bats table pins the hook's output, add rows to that table only, and no new test. Watchout 37: say in the bank that it uses nothing newer than brew 3.5.3. A2: intent/plugins/claude/skills/in-finish/SKILL.md. (a) Step 6 commits only when the user has not said not to commit; otherwise it names the paths and leaves them uncommitted. (b) Step 3 (wip.md) and step 4 (restart) write a branch's push or MR state only from a read made in that turn (git status -sb, git ls-remote, the forge's CLI); with no read, the line is left out. Text only. critic-shell on A1, critic-prose on A2. Bank refs/bank/dc/i354b/wip-v1 (separate from i354/v1, which is final). No runs.
